feature_contract.goal: Make true live-game D3D11 geometry Draw GPU pixels visible in an explicit opt-in RAW diagnostic path by collecting and selecting two independent native viewport RGB regions without corrupting the original D3D9 game backbuffer.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: live game native GPU pixel output
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One real source-owned game Draw produces two distinct native GPU BEFORE/AFTER pairs sharing a GPU EVENT and source epoch; select only physically changed source RGB.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: D3D9 source color write and fallback safety
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A later original source color write to either native tile retires the entire pair; unknown source, unavailable GPU and malformed region remain fail closed.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: portable GPU rectangle regression and exact SHA CI
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Bounded C++17 tests exercise both regions and source-write invalidation; all five untouched mandatory GitHub Actions succeed at one source SHA.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Two source-matched native D3D11 viewport/scissor pixel regions from ONE real D3D9 game Draw share a fence and the stronger actually observed RGB delta becomes the labeled RAW tile.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Separate source color writes touching either tile revoke the GPU capture; stale Present, unknown regions, overflow, false-alternate and no-RAW-mode preserve original D3D9 and no full-game publication.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 game Draw interception -> native D3D11 Draw -> two ordered GPU staging pairs -> same fence and source Present -> bounded original D3D9 RAW diagnostic tile.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Only source-authentic GPU RGB diagnostic tile output may be credited; whole native menu/car/race scene and Quest3 HMD not yet proven.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Explicit RAW visual opt-in; original D3D9 Draw, inputs, FFB, DX9Ex fallback, RT/viewport bounds and unsupported full-frame abort intact.

real_game_draw_blocker: Awaiting source-matched real-game diagnostic runtime for native_draws and native_gpu_pixel_output; old 2026-10-28 pinned zero-native run cannot be extrapolated to new SHA.
